question: Can an early net collagen decline describe the later group median, and does that identify a clearance mechanism?
system: male C57BL/6JRj mice; 12 weeks CCl4; separate sacrifice groups
measurement: Picro-Sirius-red collagen proportionate area, percent; group medians and IQR, not individual trajectories
role: retrospective internal temporal check; all values previously inspected; not independent validation
primary: healthy-offset exponential fitted exactly to day0 and day7 medians
alternatives: linear extrapolation from day0 and day7 medians
metrics: absolute error in CPA percentage points
relative absolute error to day14 median
scientific_criterion: Descriptive improvement over constant baseline if absolute error is smaller; no clinical acceptance threshold, no significance test
sensitivity: 27 combinations of q1,median,q3 for healthy,day0,day7; report prediction min/max; no probability or confidence interpretation
mechanism: X=C-h; production=qX and clearance=(r+q)X yield identical net exponential; q not identifiable from net CPA even with a perfect trajectory
illustration_scope: arbitrary mathematical counterexamples; not plausible biological bounds, calibrated treatment effects or drug predictions
publication: No source PDF or extracted table; publish original code, derived analytical metrics and caveats only
